verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a scraping and crawling service that runs workers and browser sessions, so a live metrics and pool-status dashboard is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the pack documents such a dashboard. Job-progress webhooks and per-scrape audit event streams are related but different features, and they do not deliver a real-time view of system metrics or worker/browser pool status.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monitor live system metrics and worker/browser pool status through a real-time dashboard
